description: This donut chart, titled “Task Type,” visually represents the distribution of two distinct task categories within the context of generative AI’s use in journalism, as presented in the paper “Developing Story Case Studies of Generative AI's Use in Journalism.” The chart is composed of two slices: a large, dominant red slice labeled “Article generation (83.2%)” and a smaller, yellow slice labeled “generation (16.8%)” which appears to be an incomplete or truncated label, possibly intended to read “Code generation” or “Other generation.” The red slice occupies approximately 83.2% of the chart’s area, while the yellow slice occupies the remaining 16.8%. The chart includes a legend-like structure with the percentage values displayed next to their respective labels, positioned outside the ring. There are no percentage labels embedded within the slices themselves, and the chart does not include any exploded or emphasized segments. The two slices are arranged in a descending order of size, with the larger slice positioned on the left and the smaller on the right.
